payload.text: **LESSONS candidates from 0083 and the 0082 census (2026-09-17 afternoon), vc's call at a fold.** (ll) An equivalent mutant is often a missing assertion rather than a property of the code: the refusal's list read from `_fullcycle_phases` and a literal copy printed the same bytes, and a source arm critic-shell proposed turned that mutant (M8) into a kill -- before declaring one equivalent, ask what would tell the two apart. (mm) A test comment's reason is a claim: "whichever order they ran in" held in only one order, so the arm could not see the breach it named until the order was asserted. (nn) A refutation of a success line goes vacuous the day the line is reworded, unless a green arm asserts the same text (M12 died only on that assertion). (oo) A subagent task reported "failed" -- a weekly rate limit -- after its whole report had arrived; read the hand-back before re-dispatching. (pp) A census needs its own controls: a fixture with known globs (2 matches, 0 matches) and a missing library (exit 2) are what made one hit in 103 values a measurement. And dc's, relayed: under zsh `for p in $P` does not split, so a check over nine paths tested one; BSD grep has no `-P`, so a check joined with `&&` errored rather than ran.
